text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- World support of Iraq against the unfair embargo escalates.
- France and China vow to set up a world not controlled by one superpower.
- Iraq exposes role of the United States in delaying the implementation of the oil-for-food deal.
- Russia denounces Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- U.N. trade sanctions caused the death of tens of thousands of people.
- National assembly condemns the incursion by Turkish troops into northern Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Editorial on latest efforts by China and Russia to set up a new world order not dominated by the United States.
- Article on the concept of national security in Iraq.
- Spanish companies seek to expand trade ties with Iraq.
